description: This file is a PHP source code defining a class 'CustomerOrder' which is part of the OpenCart admin extension. It manages report functionalities related to customer orders, including listing, viewing, saving configurations, and generating reports.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer order reports within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language and assets, and renders the customer order form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings, with permission checks, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the customer order report view with various statuses and data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of customer order reports by calling getReport().

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on filtering parameters such as date range, customer, and order status, and returns the report view.
